metadata.description: 面向中文开发者的 Agent Skills 与 hook 插件：文档阅读、内容整理和代码维护。按需安装，各项运行环境与权限要求见 README。

plugins.name: repo-tidy
plugins.description: Prepare branches and worktrees from the remote default branch; retain active or unverified work. Optional hooks and terminal integrations have separate setup. 安全准备任务分支与工作树，保留未证实合并的工作

plugins.name: repo-map
plugins.description: Local repository map: self-healing index of all local git repos; UserPromptSubmit hook injects path + read/write role whenever a repo name is mentioned. 本地仓库地图，提到仓库名自动注入路径

plugins.name: git-push-guard
plugins.description: Hook-only plugin: intercepts direct git push to master/main, asks for confirmation, per-repo allowlist (~/.claude/hooks/push-default-branch-allowlist.txt). 纯 hook：直推默认分支拦截

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Minimal Harness Engineering: Inspector → Worker → Reviewer loop driven by a shared TODO.md, on demand or scheduled. 三角色 AI 自治改进循环

plugins.name: do-something
plugins.description: Autonomously answer feedback, choose a task backed by real value evidence, finish and verify a durable outcome, or return NO-OP when nothing qualifies. MR mode requires separate value and execution verdicts before auto-merge. 自主推进项目，以真实价值和完成度为门，不为保持循环制造提交

plugins.name: ci-review
plugins.description: Install a CI-triggered LLM reviewer: every PR/MR gets an execution verdict; configured bot branches such as do/* also need a separate value verdict before deterministic auto-merge. Markdown behavior files are reviewed as code, and failed verdicts become red checks. CI 里的验证型代码审查机器人，机器人分支价值与执行双门禁

plugins.name: md2view
plugins.description: Re-encode Markdown into a traceable two-column reading view (diagrams, flows, matrices, cards) with every element anchored to the source; single-file HTML. Markdown 重编码为可溯源的双栏阅读视图

plugins.name: gpt-image2-prompt-director
plugins.description: Turn a weak idea into a production-grade GPT image2 brief (avatars, sticker packs, infographics, covers, posters, product shots) with a built-in benchmark. GPT image2 提示词导演 + 评测门禁

plugins.name: wechat-article-md-local
plugins.description: Save a WeChat Official Account (mp.weixin.qq.com) article as local Markdown with images downloaded. 公众号文章下载为本地 Markdown

plugins.name: x-article-download
plugins.description: Download a tweet, long-form X article or whole account to Markdown (text, images, videos, linked repos). X/Twitter 单条或整账号批量下载

plugins.name: xiaohongshu-downloader
plugins.description: Download a Xiaohongshu (RedNote) video and transcribe the voice-over with Whisper into a Markdown transcript. 小红书视频下载 + 口播逐字稿

plugins.name: doc-reader
plugins.description: Translate an English article/PDF into Chinese section by section, keep 100% of images, build a 3-column preview (original · translation · AI slides via local Codex imagegen). 英文技术文档/PDF 精准翻译 + 三栏预览

plugins.name: hkr-render
plugins.description: WeChat publishing pipeline: Markdown → styled HTML (7 themes) → cover image → draft box, multi-article; needs config.json with WeChat AppID/Secret. 公众号排版 → 封面 → 推送草稿箱

plugins.name: hook-test-kit
plugins.description: 为 Claude Code hook 脚本生成行为矩阵测试骨架：scratch fixture、stdin 喂 JSON、EMPTY/!否定断言协议、bash 坑位预修，变异实验收尾。给 hook 补行为测试

plugins.name: scanned-book-ocr
plugins.description: 扫描书 PDF 本地批量 OCR，输出页码可追溯的文本，含并发一致性基准、完整性校验和视觉抽检；支持 Apple Silicon macOS。

plugins.name: pdf-triptych
plugins.description: 把标准、规范或长技术 PDF 整理成共用横轴和颜色的一页结构图：骨架、细节、例子，附渲染与视觉检查。
